card.statement: If $\varphi: \CC^n\to\CC^m$ is a homeomorphism, then $n=m$ and there exists a basis $u_1,\dots,u_n$ of $\CC^n$ such that $\varphi u_1,\dots,\varphi u_n$ is also a basis of $\CC^n$.
card.label: Lemma vfi

paper.title: Topological classification of systems of bilinear and sesquilinear forms
paper.abstract: Let $\cal A$ and $\cal B$ be two systems consisting of the same vector spaces $\mathbb C^{n_1},\dots,\mathbb C^{n_t}$ and bilinear or sesquilinear forms $A_i,B_i:\mathbb C^{n_{k(i)}}\times\mathbb C^{n_{l(i)}}\to\mathbb C$, for $i=1,\dots,s$. We prove that $\cal A$ is transformed to $\cal B$ by homeomorphisms within $\mathbb C^{n_1},\dots,\mathbb C^{n_t}$ if and only if $\cal A$ is transformed to $\cal B$ by linear bijections within $\mathbb C^{n_1},\dots,\mathbb C^{n_t}$.
